points.name: 固定短语“看上去 / 看起来”
points.explainEn: Use 看上去/看起来 to say how someone or something seems or looks.
points.structure: 主语 + 看上去/看起来 + 形容词/短语

examples.en: He looks very young.
This dish looks delicious.

examples.zh: 你今天看起来有点儿累。
examples.en: You look a little tired today.

exercises.q: 填空：这个地方看___很安静。
翻译：You look a little tired today.
exercises.a: 你今天看起来有点儿累。
exercises.body: You look a little tired today.

exercises.q: 用“看起来”改写：他好像很高兴。

points.note: “看上去”和“看起来”在表示外表印象时基本可以互换。
points.noteEn: 看上去 and 看起来 are basically interchangeable for outward impression.

points.name: 疑问代词的非疑问用法（1）
points.pinyin: yíwèn dàicí de fēi yíwèn yòngfǎ (yī)
points.explainEn: A question word can mean an unknown or non-specific person, thing, or place in a statement.
points.structure: 谁 / 什么 / 哪儿 / 哪 + ……（不真正提问）

examples.en: I seem to have seen him somewhere.
I want to eat something.
Let us find someone to ask.

exercises.q: 填空：我好像在___见过他。
翻译：I want to eat something.
选择：表示“不确定的某个人”可以用（谁 / 都）。
exercises.body: 表示“不确定的某个人”可以用（谁 / 都）。

points.note: 这里的疑问代词不要求对方回答具体的人、事物或地点。
points.noteEn: Here the question word doesn't ask for a specific person/thing/place.

points.name: 多项定语
points.explainEn: When several words describe one noun, put them before the noun in a natural order.
points.structure: 时间/处所 + 动作/状态 + 特点 + 的 + 名词

examples.en: This is the new book I bought yesterday.

examples.zh: 那个穿白衣服的年轻人是我朋友。
examples.en: That young person in white is my friend.

examples.zh: 我喜欢那张在北京拍的照片。
examples.en: I like that photo taken in Beijing.

exercises.q: 排序：我昨天买的 / 新 / 书 / 这是
exercises.body: 我昨天买的 / 新 / 书 / 这是

exercises.q: 翻译：That young person in white is my friend.
exercises.a: 那个穿白衣服的年轻人是我朋友。
exercises.body: That young person in white is my friend.

exercises.q: 补全：我喜欢那张___照片。（在北京拍）
exercises.body: 我喜欢那张___照片。（在北京拍）

points.note: 多项定语的顺序较复杂，本级先掌握常见顺序，不要求一次记住所有规则。
points.noteEn: Multiple modifiers are complex; just learn the common order for now.

lessons.title: 你们想吃什么就点什么

points.name: 并列复句“又……又……”
points.explainEn: Use 又…又… to say two qualities or actions are both true.
points.structure: 又 + 形容词/动词 + 又 + 形容词/动词

examples.en: This dish is cheap and delicious.

examples.zh: 这个小区又干净又安静。
examples.en: This neighborhood is clean and quiet.
He is tall and thin.

exercises.q: 填空：这个菜___便宜___好吃。
翻译：This neighborhood is clean and quiet.
exercises.a: 这个小区又干净又安静。
exercises.body: This neighborhood is clean and quiet.

exercises.q: 连接：她很认真。她很热情。

points.note: “又……又……”连接的两个部分通常词性相同。
points.noteEn: The two parts joined by 又…又… are usually the same word class.

points.name: 疑问代词的非疑问用法（2）
points.pinyin: yíwèn dàicí de fēi yíwèn yòngfǎ (èr)
points.explainEn: Use a question word + 都/也 to mean everyone, everything, anywhere, etc.
points.structure: 疑问代词 + 都/也 + 谓语

examples.en: Anyone can take part.
I eat everything.
You can go anywhere.

exercises.q: 填空：___都可以参加。
翻译：I eat everything.
补全：你___都可以去。

points.note: 此时“谁、什么、哪儿”等表示一个范围里的任何一个，不是在提问。
points.noteEn: Here 谁/什么/哪儿 mean "any one" within a range, not a question.

points.name: 疑问代词的非疑问用法（3）
points.pinyin: yíwèn dàicí de fēi yíwèn yòngfǎ (sān)
points.explainEn: Repeat the same question word in two parts to mean “whatever / whoever / wherever…”.
points.structure: 疑问代词 + ……，就 + 同一疑问代词 + ……

examples.en: Order whatever you want to eat.
I will go wherever you go.
Whoever wants to join can join.

exercises.q: 填空：你想吃什么就点___。
翻译：I will go wherever you go.
exercises.body: I will go wherever you go.

exercises.q: 补全：谁想去，___。

points.note: 前后通常使用同一个疑问代词，表示自由选择或对应关系。
points.noteEn: The same question word appears twice, for free choice or correspondence.

points.name: 程度副词“挺”
points.explainEn: Use 挺 + adjective + 的 to mean “quite / pretty”.
points.structure: 挺 + 形容词 +（的）

examples.en: This neighborhood is quite quiet.
It is pretty cold today.
This book is quite interesting.

exercises.q: 填空：今天___冷的。
翻译：This book is quite interesting.
排序：挺 / 这个地方 / 安静 / 的
exercises.body: 挺 / 这个地方 / 安静 / 的

points.note: 口语中很常见，句末经常带“的”。
points.noteEn: Very common in speech, often ending with 的.

points.name: 程度补语（1）：形容词/动词 + 坏了
points.explainEn: Use 坏了 after some adjectives or verbs to mean an extremely high degree.
points.structure: 形容词/动词 + 坏了

examples.en: I am extremely tired today.
He has been extremely busy these days.
The child is extremely happy.

exercises.q: 填空：我今天累___。
翻译：The child is extremely happy.
用“坏了”改写：他非常忙。

points.note: 这里的“坏了”不是“变坏”，而是程度补语，表示程度非常高。
points.noteEn: Here 坏了 isn't "gone bad"; it's a degree complement meaning "extremely".

points.name: 副词“就”和“才”
points.explainEn: 就 often shows early, fast, or easy. 才 often shows late, slow, or only then.
points.structure: 时间/条件 + 就/才 + 动词

examples.en: He got up as early as six.
I did not arrive at school until nine.

examples.zh: 这儿很近，走十分钟就到。
examples.en: It is close; you can get there in ten minutes.

exercises.q: 填空：他六点___到了。
填空：我等了半小时，他___来。
翻译：It takes only ten minutes to walk there.
exercises.body: It takes only ten minutes to walk there.

points.note: “就”常让人感觉早、快、容易；“才”常让人感觉晚、慢、少。
points.noteEn: 就 feels early/fast/easy; 才 feels late/slow/few.

lessons.title: 这家宾馆跟别的都不一样

points.name: 固定格式“一……也/都 + 不/没……”
points.explainEn: Use 一…也/都不/没… to mean “not even one / not at all”.
points.structure: 一 + 量词 + 名词 + 也/都 + 不/没 + 谓语

examples.en: I did not eat even one apple.
He did not say a single word.
I am not tired at all today.

exercises.q: 填空：我一个苹果___没吃。
翻译：He did not say a single word.
exercises.body: He did not say a single word.

exercises.q: 改写：我不累。（用“一点儿也……”）

points.note: “没”多否定已经发生的动作；“不”多否定习惯、状态或意愿。
points.noteEn: 没 negates completed actions; 不 negates habits, states or intentions.

points.name: 比较句（9）：“A 跟 B 一样 / 不一样”
points.explainEn: Use A 跟 B 一样 to say A and B are the same; use 不一样 for different.
points.structure: A + 跟 + B + 一样（+ 形容词）/ 不一样

examples.en: He is as tall as I am.

examples.zh: 这家宾馆跟别的不一样。
examples.en: This hotel is different from the others.
My book is the same as yours.

exercises.q: 填空：他___我一样高。
翻译：This hotel is different from the others.
exercises.a: 这家宾馆跟别的不一样。
exercises.body: This hotel is different from the others.

exercises.q: 改成不同：我的书跟你的一样。

points.note: “一样”后面可以再接形容词说明哪方面一样。
points.noteEn: 一样 can be followed by an adjective saying in what way they're alike.

points.name: 固定格式“除了……（以外），……都/还/也……”
points.explainEn: Use 除了…以外 for “except for…” or “besides…”.
points.structure: 除了 + X +（以外），其他 + 都… / 还/也…

examples.zh: 除了我以外，大家都到了。
examples.en: Everyone arrived except me.

examples.zh: 除了汉语以外，我还学英语。
examples.en: Besides Chinese, I also study English.

examples.zh: 除了苹果，我也喜欢西瓜。
examples.en: Besides apples, I also like watermelon.

exercises.q: 填空：除了我___，大家都到了。
翻译：Besides Chinese, I also study English.
exercises.a: 除了汉语以外，我还学英语。
exercises.body: Besides Chinese, I also study English.

exercises.q: 选择：表示“除他之外大家都来”，用“大家（都 / 还）来了”。
exercises.body: 表示“除他之外大家都来”，用“大家（都 / 还）来了”。

points.note: “都”常表示排除一个例外；“还/也”常表示另外增加一项。
points.noteEn: 都 marks an exception (except…); 还/也 add one more.

points.name: 程度补语（2）：形容词 + 得很
points.explainEn: Use adjective + 得很 to mean “very / extremely”.
points.structure: 形容词 + 得很

examples.en: This neighborhood is very quiet.
It is very cold today.
This dish is very delicious.

exercises.q: 填空：今天冷___。
翻译：This neighborhood is very quiet.
用“得很”改写：这个菜非常好吃。

points.note: “得很”放在形容词后，口语中表示程度很高。
points.noteEn: 得很 after an adjective means "very" in speech.

points.name: 量词重叠
points.explainEn: Repeat a measure word to mean “every one / each one”.
points.structure: 量词重叠 + 都 + 谓语

examples.zh: 这些照片张张都很好看。
examples.en: Every one of these photos looks good.
Every one of these apples is sweet.

examples.zh: 这些衣服件件都很漂亮。
examples.en: Every piece of clothing is beautiful.

exercises.q: 填空：这些照片___都很好看。
翻译：Every apple is sweet.
把“件”变成重叠形式。

points.note: 量词重叠通常和“都”搭配，表示没有例外。
points.noteEn: Reduplicated measure words pair with 都 to mean "without exception".

points.name: 存现句（3）：地点 + 动词 + 趋向/结果 + 数量 + 人/物
points.explainEn: Use place + movement/result verb + an indefinite person/thing to say someone or something appears or moves into a scene.
points.structure: 地点 + 动词 + 趋向/结果补语 + 数量 + 人/物

examples.en: A car is coming from ahead.
A person walked in through the door.
Two children are running over from behind.

exercises.q: 填空：门口走进来___人。
翻译：A car is coming from ahead.
exercises.body: A car is coming from ahead.

exercises.q: 排序：两个孩子 / 后边 / 跑过来
exercises.body: 两个孩子 / 后边 / 跑过来

points.note: 句末的人或物通常是不确定、第一次出现的信息。
points.noteEn: The person/thing at the end is usually new, indefinite information.

points.name: 紧缩复句“……了……就……”
points.explainEn: Use …了…就… when one action finishes and the next action follows soon after.
points.structure: 动作1 + 了（宾语），就 + 动作2

examples.en: I will go to school after I eat.
He goes home as soon as class ends.
Call me when you arrive.

exercises.q: 填空：我吃___饭就去学校。
翻译：Call me when you arrive.
排序：就 / 下了课 / 他 / 回家
exercises.body: 就 / 下了课 / 他 / 回家

points.note: 两个动作有明显的先后关系，第二个动作紧接着第一个动作。
points.noteEn: The two actions are clearly ordered; the second follows right after.

points.name: 固定格式“该……了”
points.explainEn: Use 该…了 to mean “it is time to…” or “should now…”.
points.structure: 该 + 动词 + 了

examples.en: It is time to eat.
It is time for us to leave.
You should rest now.

exercises.q: 填空：我们___出发___。
翻译：It is time to eat.
用“该……了”改写：现在你应该休息。

points.note: 表示到了做某事的时间，常带提醒语气。
points.noteEn: Marks that it's time to do something, often as a reminder.

points.name: 假设复句“如果……，就……”
points.explainEn: Use 如果…就… for “if…then…”.
points.structure: 如果 + 条件，就 + 结果

examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去了。
examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will not go.

examples.zh: 如果你累了，就休息一下。
examples.en: If you are tired, take a rest.

examples.zh: 如果有时间，我就去看你。
examples.en: If I have time, I will go see you.

exercises.q: 填空：___明天下雨，我们___不去。
翻译：If you are tired, take a rest.
exercises.a: 如果你累了，就休息一下。
exercises.body: If you are tired, take a rest.

exercises.q: 连接：你有时间。你给我打电话。
exercises.a: 如果你有时间，就给我打电话。
exercises.body: 你有时间。你给我打电话。

points.note: “如果”提出假设条件，“就”引出相应结果。
points.noteEn: 如果 sets a hypothetical; 就 gives the result.

points.name: 固定短语“越来越”
points.explainEn: Use 越来越 + adjective/mental verb to mean “more and more…”.
points.structure: 越来越 + 形容词 / 心理动词

examples.en: The weather is getting colder and colder.
His Chinese is getting better and better.

examples.zh: 我越来越喜欢这个城市了。
examples.en: I like this city more and more.

exercises.q: 填空：天气___冷了。
翻译：His Chinese is getting better and better.
exercises.body: His Chinese is getting better and better.

exercises.q: 排序：越来越 / 我 / 喜欢 / 中文
exercises.body: 越来越 / 我 / 喜欢 / 中文

points.note: “越来越”后面通常直接接形容词或少数心理动词。
points.noteEn: 越来越 is usually followed directly by an adjective or a few mental verbs.

lessons.title: 那条裙子比短裤更好看

points.name: 连动句（2）：动词1 + 着 + 动词2
points.explainEn: Use V1着 + V2 when the first action/state is the manner or background of the second action.
points.structure: 主语 + 动词1 + 着 +（宾语）+ 动词2

examples.en: She talks to me with a smile.
He walked in holding a book.
We chat while sitting.

exercises.q: 填空：她笑___说话。
翻译：He walked in holding a book.
exercises.body: He walked in holding a book.

exercises.q: 排序：坐着 / 我们 / 聊天
exercises.body: 坐着 / 我们 / 聊天

points.note: V1表示伴随状态或方式，V2是主要动作。
points.noteEn: V1 is the accompanying manner; V2 is the main action.

points.name: 比较句（10）：“A 不比 B + 形容词”
points.explainEn: Use A 不比 B + adjective to say A is not more … than B. It does not always mean A is less.
points.structure: A + 不比 + B + 形容词

examples.en: Today is not colder than yesterday.
I am not taller than my older sister.
This one is not more expensive than that one.

exercises.q: 填空：今天___昨天冷。
翻译：This one is not more expensive than that one.
exercises.body: This one is not more expensive than that one.

exercises.q: 改写：姐姐可能和我一样高。（用“不比”表达“我不更高”）
exercises.body: 姐姐可能和我一样高。（用“不比”表达“我不更高”）

points.note: “A不比B高”只说明A没有比B更高，A可能一样高，也可能更矮。
points.noteEn: A 不比 B 高 only means A isn't taller; A may be equal or shorter.

points.name: 程度补语（3）：形容词/动词 + 极了
points.explainEn: Use 极了 after an adjective or feeling verb to mean “extremely”.
points.structure: 形容词/心理动词 + 极了

examples.en: This skirt is extremely beautiful.
It is extremely cold today.
I like it very much.

exercises.q: 填空：这条裙子漂亮___。
翻译：It is extremely cold today.
用“极了”改写：我非常喜欢。

points.note: “极了”放在形容词或少数心理动词后，程度比“很”强。
points.noteEn: 极了 after an adjective/mental verb is stronger than 很.

points.name: 递进复句“不但……，而且……”
points.explainEn: Use 不但…而且… for “not only…, but also…”.
points.structure: 不但 + A，而且 + B

examples.zh: 这条裙子不但好看，而且很便宜。
examples.en: This skirt is not only pretty but also cheap.

examples.zh: 他不但会说中文，而且会写汉字。
examples.en: He can not only speak Chinese but also write Chinese characters.

examples.zh: 这个小区不但安静，而且很方便。
examples.en: This neighborhood is not only quiet but also convenient.

exercises.q: 填空：他___会说中文，___会写汉字。
翻译：This neighborhood is not only quiet but also convenient.
exercises.a: 这个小区不但安静，而且很方便。
exercises.body: This neighborhood is not only quiet but also convenient.

exercises.q: 连接：这个菜好吃。这个菜便宜。
exercises.a: 这个菜不但好吃，而且便宜。
exercises.body: 这个菜好吃。这个菜便宜。

points.note: 后一个分句通常比前一个分句增加一层信息。
points.noteEn: The second clause adds a further layer to the first.

points.name: 趋向补语的引申用法（1）：表示结果意义
points.explainEn: Some direction words can show a result, not real physical direction, such as 出、起、下.
points.structure: 动词 + 出/起/下

examples.zh: 我终于想出一个好办法。
examples.en: I finally came up with a good idea.

examples.zh: 我突然想起他的名字了。
examples.en: I suddenly remembered his name.
Please write down my phone number.

exercises.q: 填空：我终于想___一个办法。
翻译：I suddenly remembered his name.
exercises.a: 我突然想起他的名字了。

exercises.q: 选择：表示“write down”用“记（下 / 去）”。
exercises.body: 表示“write down”用“记（下 / 去）”。

points.note: 这里“出、起、下”主要表示动作产生了某种结果，不一定是真正的空间方向。
points.noteEn: Here 出/起/下 mark a result, not necessarily real spatial direction.

points.name: 离合词（2）
points.explainEn: A separable verb can have 了, a duration, or a quantity inserted between its two parts.
points.structure: A + 了/时量/数量 + B

examples.en: I stayed in the hospital for one week.
We had class for two hours.
I had a good sleep last night.

exercises.q: 把“住院”加入“一个星期”：我___。
翻译：We had class for two hours.
exercises.body: We had class for two hours.

exercises.q: 选择：正确的是（睡了一个好觉 / 睡觉了一个好）。
exercises.body: 正确的是（睡了一个好觉 / 睡觉了一个好）。

points.note: 离合词中间可以插入动态助词、时量或数量成分，不能总把它当作普通双音节动词。
points.noteEn: Separable verbs can take particles/duration/quantity inside; not ordinary two-syllable verbs.

points.name: 时量补语（2）：表示动作结束后到现在的时间
points.explainEn: Use a duration after a completed/change verb + 了 to say how long it has been since that event.
points.structure: 主语 + 动词/变化 + 时段 + 了

examples.en: It has been two years since I came to China.
It has been three years since he graduated.
It has been three weeks since school started.

exercises.q: 填空：他毕业三年___。
翻译：It has been two years since I came to China.
exercises.body: It has been two years since I came to China.

exercises.q: 排序：三个星期 / 开学 / 了
exercises.body: 三个星期 / 开学 / 了

points.note: 本点强调“从某动作完成/某变化发生，到现在已经过了多久”。
points.noteEn: Focus: how long it's been since an action finished or a change occurred.

points.name: 固定格式“（在）……以前/以后/前/后”
points.explainEn: Use 以前/前 for “before” and 以后/后 for “after”.
points.structure: （在）+ 动作/时间 + 以前/以后；名词/动作 + 前/后

examples.zh: 睡觉前我会看一会儿书。
examples.en: I read for a while before sleeping.
We go eat after class.

examples.zh: 来中国以前，我没吃过饺子。
examples.en: Before coming to China, I had never eaten jiaozi.

exercises.q: 填空：下课___我们去吃饭。
翻译：Before coming to China, I had never eaten jiaozi.
exercises.a: 来中国以前，我没吃过饺子。
exercises.body: Before coming to China, I had never eaten jiaozi.

exercises.q: 用“前”改写：在睡觉以前，我喝水。

points.note: “以前/以后”可以跟较长短语；“前/后”更简洁。
points.noteEn: 以前/以后 take longer phrases; 前/后 are more concise.

points.name: 目的复句“为了……，……”
points.explainEn: Use 为了 + goal to mean “in order to / for the purpose of…”.
points.structure: 为了 + 目的，主语 + 动作

examples.zh: 为了学好中文，我每天练习。
examples.en: To learn Chinese well, I practice every day.

examples.zh: 为了身体健康，他每天跑步。
examples.en: For his health, he runs every day.

examples.zh: 为了不迟到，我们早点儿出发吧。
examples.en: Let us leave early so we will not be late.

exercises.q: 填空：___学好中文，我每天练习。
翻译：For his health, he runs every day.
exercises.a: 为了身体健康，他每天跑步。
exercises.body: For his health, he runs every day.

exercises.q: 连接：不迟到。我们早点儿出发。
exercises.a: 为了不迟到，我们早点儿出发。
exercises.body: 不迟到。我们早点儿出发。

points.note: “为了”后面是目的，后面的句子说明为这个目的做什么。
points.noteEn: 为了 states the purpose; the clause tells what's done for it.

points.name: 可能补语
points.explainEn: Use V得/不 + result/direction word to say an action can or cannot reach a result.
points.structure: 动词 + 得/不 + 补语

examples.en: I can understand this character.
The sound is too low; I cannot hear it.
I cannot carry so many things.

exercises.q: 填空：这个字我看___懂。
翻译：I cannot hear it.
选择：太重了，我拿（得动 / 不动）。
exercises.body: 太重了，我拿（得动 / 不动）。

points.note: 可能补语强调“能不能达到某个结果”，不是一般的“能 + 动词”。
points.noteEn: A potential complement asks if a result is achievable, unlike 能 + verb.

points.name: 固定格式“越A越B”
points.explainEn: Use 越 A 越 B to mean “the more A, the more B”.
points.structure: 越 + A + 越 + B

examples.zh: 天气越冷，我越想喝热茶。
examples.en: The colder it gets, the more I want hot tea.
The more he talks, the faster he speaks.
The more I study Chinese, the more interesting it becomes.

exercises.q: 翻译：The more I study Chinese, the more interesting it becomes.
exercises.body: The more I study Chinese, the more interesting it becomes.

exercises.q: 排序：越 / 天气 / 越 / 冷 / 我 / 不想出去
exercises.a: 天气越冷，我越不想出去。
exercises.body: 越 / 天气 / 越 / 冷 / 我 / 不想出去

points.note: 两个“越”后面都可以接动作或状态。
points.noteEn: After each 越 you can put an action or a state.

points.name: “把”字句（1）：把 + 宾语 + 动词 + 在/到 + 地点
points.explainEn: Use 把 when an action moves or puts a specific object in a place.
points.structure: 主语 + 把 + 宾语 + 动词 + 在/到 + 地点

examples.en: Please put the book on the table.

examples.zh: 我把水果放到冰箱里了。
examples.en: I put the fruit in the refrigerator.
He put the phone in the schoolbag.

exercises.q: 填空：请___书放在桌子上。
翻译：I put the fruit in the refrigerator.
exercises.a: 我把水果放到冰箱里了。
exercises.body: I put the fruit in the refrigerator.

exercises.q: 排序：手机 / 他 / 把 / 放在 / 书包里
exercises.body: 手机 / 他 / 把 / 放在 / 书包里

points.note: “把”后的宾语通常是明确、已知的事物；本点重点是动作后的地点。
points.noteEn: The 把 object is definite; focus here is the place after the verb.

points.name: 固定格式“在……上/中/下”
points.explainEn: Use 在…上 for an aspect, 在…中 for a situation/process, and 在…下 for a condition.
points.structure: 在 + 名词 + 上/中/下

examples.en: He is very serious in his studies.

examples.zh: 我们在生活中互相帮助。
examples.en: We help each other in daily life.

examples.zh: 在老师的帮助下，我进步很快。
examples.en: With the teacher’s help, I improved quickly.

exercises.q: 填空：在老师的帮助___，我进步很快。
exercises.body: 在老师的帮助___，我进步很快。

exercises.q: 翻译：We help each other in daily life.
exercises.a: 我们在生活中互相帮助。
exercises.body: We help each other in daily life.

exercises.q: 选择：表示“在学习方面”用“在学习（上 / 下）”。
exercises.body: 表示“在学习方面”用“在学习（上 / 下）”。

points.note: 这里的“上/中/下”不是简单方位词，而表示方面、环境或条件。
points.noteEn: Here 上/中/下 mark an aspect/environment/condition, not location.

points.name: “把”字句（2）：把 + 宾语 + 动词 + 给 + 人
points.explainEn: Use 把 + object + verb + 给 + person when an object is transferred to someone.
points.structure: 主语 + 把 + 宾语 + 动词 + 给 + 人

examples.en: Return the book to me tomorrow.
I sent the photo to my friend.
She gave the gift to the teacher.

exercises.q: 填空：请把书还___我。
翻译：I sent the photo to my friend.
exercises.body: I sent the photo to my friend.

exercises.q: 排序：礼物 / 她 / 把 / 送给 / 老师了
exercises.body: 礼物 / 她 / 把 / 送给 / 老师了

points.note: 本点重点是动作的接受者，用“给 + 人”表示。
points.noteEn: Focus: the recipient, shown with 给 + person.

lessons.title: 看来我没办法解决这个问题

points.name: “还是”和“或者”
points.explainEn: Use 还是 in a choice question. Use 或者 in a statement.
points.structure: 问句：A 还是 B？；陈述句：A 或者 B

examples.en: Do you want tea or coffee?

examples.zh: 坐地铁或者坐公交车都可以。
examples.en: The subway or the bus is fine.
Are you going today or tomorrow?

exercises.q: 填空：你喝茶___咖啡？
填空：今天___明天都可以。
翻译：The subway or the bus is fine.
exercises.a: 坐地铁或者坐公交车都可以。
exercises.body: The subway or the bus is fine.

points.note: 最简单记法：选择问句用“还是”，陈述句表示选择通常用“或者”。
points.noteEn: Simple rule: 还是 in choice questions, 或者 in statements.

points.name: 固定短语“看来”
points.explainEn: Use 看来 to introduce a conclusion based on what you see or know: “it seems / apparently”.
points.structure: 看来，+ 判断/结论

examples.en: It looks like it is going to rain today.
It seems he is not coming today.

examples.zh: 这个问题很难，看来我要请老师帮忙。
examples.en: This problem is hard; it seems I need the teacher’s help.

exercises.q: 填空：___今天要下雨。
翻译：It seems he is not coming today.
exercises.body: It seems he is not coming today.

exercises.q: 用“看来”表达：这个问题很难，我需要帮助。
exercises.a: 这个问题很难，看来我需要帮助。
exercises.body: 这个问题很难，我需要帮助。

points.note: “看来”表示根据已有情况作出判断。
points.noteEn: 看来 marks a judgement based on the situation.

points.name: “把”字句（3）：把 + 宾语 + 动词 + 结果补语
points.explainEn: Use 把 + object + verb + result complement to show the result of an action on the object.
points.structure: 主语 + 把 + 宾语 + 动词 + 结果补语

examples.en: I finished the homework.
Please close the door.
He cleaned the room.

exercises.q: 填空：我把作业写___了。
翻译：Please close the door.
排序：房间 / 他 / 把 / 打扫干净了
exercises.body: 房间 / 他 / 把 / 打扫干净了

points.note: 动词后要有结果，不能只说“我把作业写”。
points.noteEn: The verb needs a result; you can't just say 我把作业写.

points.name: 固定格式“对……来说”
points.explainEn: Use 对…来说 to mean “for… / from the point of view of…”.
points.structure: 对 + 人/事物 + 来说，……

examples.en: For me, health is the most important.

examples.zh: 对学生来说，这个问题有点儿难。
examples.en: For students, this question is a little difficult.

examples.zh: 对他来说，学中文很有意思。
examples.en: For him, learning Chinese is interesting.

exercises.q: 填空：___我___，家人最重要。
翻译：For students, this question is difficult.
exercises.a: 对学生来说，这个问题很难。
exercises.body: For students, this question is difficult.

exercises.q: 排序：来说 / 对他 / 中文 / 很有意思
exercises.a: 对他来说，中文很有意思。
exercises.body: 来说 / 对他 / 中文 / 很有意思

points.note: 表示一个评价或判断是从谁的角度出发。
points.noteEn: Marks whose viewpoint an opinion comes from.

lessons.title: 这个季节天气变化很快

points.name: 选择复句“或者……，或者……”
points.explainEn: Use 或者…或者… in a statement to list two possible choices.
points.structure: 或者 + A，或者 + B

examples.zh: 周末我们或者去公园，或者在家休息。
examples.en: On the weekend, we either go to the park or rest at home.

examples.zh: 你可以或者坐地铁，或者坐公交车。
examples.en: You can either take the subway or the bus.

examples.zh: 晚饭或者吃米饭，或者吃面条。
examples.en: For dinner, we can eat rice or noodles.

exercises.q: 填空：周末___去公园，___在家休息。
翻译：We can take the subway or the bus.
exercises.a: 我们或者坐地铁，或者坐公交车。
exercises.body: We can take the subway or the bus.

exercises.q: 用“或者……或者……”表达两个晚饭选择。
exercises.a: 晚饭或者吃米饭，或者吃面条。

points.note: 这是陈述句的选择关系，不是问句，因此不用“还是”。
points.noteEn: This is a statement's "either…or", not a question, so no 还是.

points.name: 趋向补语的引申用法（2）：表示开始
points.explainEn: Use 上 or 起来 after some verbs/adjectives to show a new action or state begins.
points.structure: 动词/形容词 + 上/起来

examples.en: The weather has started to get cold.
Everyone started laughing.
I gradually came to like Chinese.

exercises.q: 填空：大家笑___了。
翻译：I came to like Chinese.
选择：表示“开始变冷”用“冷（起来 / 下去）”。
exercises.body: 表示“开始变冷”用“冷（起来 / 下去）”。

points.note: 这里的“上/起来”表示动作或状态从没有到开始出现。
points.noteEn: Here 上/起来 mark an action or state beginning to appear.

points.name: 范围副词“就”表示范围小/数量少
points.explainEn: Use 就 to mean “only / just” when the range or amount is small.
points.structure: 就 + 数量/人/事物 + 谓语；主语 + 就 + V + 数量

examples.en: Only I am at home today.
I brought only two books.
He drank only one glass of water.

exercises.q: 填空：今天___我一个人在家。
翻译：I brought only two books.
选择：表示数量少用（就 / 才）带了两本书。
exercises.body: 表示数量少用（就 / 才）带了两本书。

points.note: 本点的“就”强调范围或数量很小，意思接近“只”。
points.noteEn: Here 就 stresses a small scope/amount, close to 只.

points.name: 趋向补语的引申用法（3）：表示持续
points.explainEn: Use 下去/下来 after a verb to show an action or state continues or is kept.
points.structure: 动词 + 下去/下来

examples.en: Please continue speaking.
We need to keep going.

examples.zh: 这个好习惯要保持下来。
examples.en: This good habit should be kept.

exercises.q: 填空：请继续说___。
翻译：We need to keep going.
选择：表示“保持这个习惯”用“保持（下来 / 出来）”。
exercises.body: 表示“保持这个习惯”用“保持（下来 / 出来）”。

points.note: “下去”常强调继续向后发展；“下来”常表示保存、保持到后面。
points.noteEn: 下去 stresses continuing on; 下来 stresses keeping/settling.

points.name: 假设复句“……的话，就……”
points.explainEn: Put 的话 after a condition to mean “if…”, often followed by 就.
points.structure: 条件 + 的话，就 + 结果

examples.zh: 明天下雨的话，我们就不去了。
examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will not go.
If you are tired, take a rest.

examples.zh: 有时间的话，就来我家玩儿吧。
examples.en: If you have time, come to my home.

exercises.q: 填空：明天下雨___，我们就不去。
翻译：If you are tired, take a rest.
exercises.body: If you are tired, take a rest.

exercises.q: 补全：有时间___，就给我打电话。

points.note: “的话”放在条件后面；前面可以省略“如果”。
points.noteEn: 的话 follows the condition; 如果 can be dropped in front.

points.name: “把”字句（4）：把 + 宾语 + 动词 + 趋向补语
points.explainEn: Use 把 + object + verb + direction complement to show how the object moves or changes position.
points.structure: 主语 + 把 + 宾语 + 动词 + 趋向补语

examples.en: Please take the book out.
Take the cup inside.
The teacher called him over.

exercises.q: 填空：请把书拿___。
翻译：Take the cup inside.
选择：叫某人到说话人这里，用“叫（过来 / 过去）”。
exercises.body: 叫某人到说话人这里，用“叫（过来 / 过去）”。

points.note: 本点强调“把”字句中的趋向补语，如出来、进去、过来、回去等。
points.noteEn: Focus: directional complements in the 把 sentence, e.g. 出来/进去/过来/回去.

points.name: 并列复句“一边……，一边……”
points.explainEn: Use 一边…一边… for two actions happening at the same time.
points.structure: 一边 + 动作1，一边 + 动作2

examples.zh: 我一边吃饭，一边看电视。
examples.en: I eat while watching TV.

examples.zh: 她一边走路，一边听音乐。
examples.en: She listens to music while walking.

examples.zh: 我们一边喝茶，一边聊天。
examples.en: We drink tea and chat at the same time.

exercises.q: 填空：我___吃饭，___看电视。
翻译：She listens to music while walking.
exercises.a: 她一边走路，一边听音乐。
exercises.body: She listens to music while walking.

exercises.q: 排序：一边 / 我们 / 聊天 / 一边 / 喝茶
exercises.a: 我们一边喝茶，一边聊天。
exercises.body: 一边 / 我们 / 聊天 / 一边 / 喝茶

points.note: 两个动作通常可以同时进行。
points.noteEn: The two actions usually happen at the same time.

points.name: 被动句（1）：“被”字句
points.explainEn: Use 被 to say the subject receives an action: “be done by…”.
points.structure: A + 被 + B + 动词 + 其他成分

examples.en: This book was borrowed by someone else.
My apple was eaten by my younger brother.
The door was opened by the wind.

exercises.q: 填空：这本书___别人借走了。
翻译：My apple was eaten by my younger brother.
exercises.body: My apple was eaten by my younger brother.

exercises.q: 排序：被 / 门 / 风 / 打开了
exercises.body: 被 / 门 / 风 / 打开了

points.note: HSK3先掌握基本“被”字句；动作后通常要有结果、数量或其他成分。
points.noteEn: Learn the basic 被 sentence; the verb needs a result/quantity/etc.

points.name: 承接复句“先……，再/然后……”
points.explainEn: Use 先…再/然后… to show the order of actions.
points.structure: 先 + 动作1，再/然后 + 动作2

examples.en: First I eat, then I do homework.
Wash your hands first, then eat.

examples.zh: 我们先坐地铁，然后走十分钟。
examples.en: First we take the subway, then walk for ten minutes.

exercises.q: 填空：我___吃饭，___做作业。
翻译：Wash your hands first, then eat.
exercises.body: Wash your hands first, then eat.

exercises.q: 排序：然后 / 我们 / 回家 / 先 / 买东西
exercises.a: 我们先买东西，然后回家。
exercises.body: 然后 / 我们 / 回家 / 先 / 买东西

points.note: “再”常用于下一步动作；“然后”连接前后两个步骤也很常见。
points.noteEn: 再 is for the next step; 然后 also commonly links two steps.

points.name: 固定格式“X什么（啊）”
points.explainEn: Use X什么啊 to reject or question an evaluation: “What do you mean X? / Not X at all!”.
points.structure: 形容词/动词 + 什么（啊）

examples.zh: 累什么啊，我一点儿也不累。
examples.en: Tired? I am not tired at all.
Expensive? It is only twenty yuan.
Difficult? This is very easy.

exercises.q: 填空：___什么啊，我一点儿也不累。（tired）
翻译：Expensive? It is only twenty yuan.
exercises.body: Expensive? It is only twenty yuan.

exercises.q: 用“X什么啊”回答：A：这个很难。B：___，很简单。

points.note: 很口语，常用于反驳对方刚才的判断，语气要结合场景使用。
points.noteEn: Very colloquial; used to rebut what was just said—mind the context.

points.name: 介词“根据”
points.explainEn: Use 根据 to mean “according to / based on”.
points.structure: 根据 + 信息/情况/规定，……

examples.zh: 根据天气预报，明天会下雨。
examples.en: According to the weather forecast, it will rain tomorrow.

examples.zh: 根据规定，这里不能停车。
examples.en: According to the rules, you cannot park here.

examples.zh: 我们根据地图找到了这个地方。
examples.en: We found this place using the map.

exercises.q: 填空：___天气预报，明天会下雨。
翻译：According to the rules, you cannot park here.
exercises.a: 根据规定，这里不能停车。
exercises.body: According to the rules, you cannot park here.

exercises.q: 排序：根据 / 地图 / 我们 / 找到了 / 这里
exercises.a: 我们根据地图找到了这里。
exercises.body: 根据 / 地图 / 我们 / 找到了 / 这里

points.note: “根据”后面是判断、行动所依据的信息或标准。
points.noteEn: 根据 is followed by the basis for a judgement or action.

points.name: 数量重叠“数词 + 量词 + 数词 + 量词”
points.pinyin: shùliàng chóngdié: shùcí + liàngcí + shùcí + liàngcí
points.explainEn: Repeat a number-measure phrase to mean people/things act in groups or one by one.
points.structure: 数词 + 量词 + 数词 + 量词 +（地）+ 动词

examples.en: Please come in one by one.
The students practice in pairs.
Look at the photos one by one.

exercises.q: 填空：请一个___地进来。
翻译：The students practice in pairs.
把“照片”表达成“一张一张地看”。

points.note: 表示按固定数量分组或依次进行，常加“地”修饰后面的动作。
points.noteEn: Means in fixed groups or one by one, often with 地 before the verb.

points.name: 固定短语“在……看来”
points.explainEn: Use 在…看来 to mean “in someone’s view / in the opinion of…”.
points.structure: 在 + 人/群体 + 看来，……

examples.en: In my view, health is the most important.

examples.zh: 在老师看来，他进步很大。
examples.en: In the teacher’s view, he has improved a lot.

examples.zh: 在很多人看来，这个办法不错。
examples.en: In many people’s view, this method is good.

exercises.q: 填空：___我___，这不难。
翻译：In the teacher’s view, he improved a lot.
exercises.a: 在老师看来，他进步很大。
exercises.body: In the teacher’s view, he improved a lot.

exercises.q: 排序：看来 / 在很多人 / 这个地方 / 很漂亮
exercises.a: 在很多人看来，这个地方很漂亮。
exercises.body: 看来 / 在很多人 / 这个地方 / 很漂亮

points.note: 和“看来”不同，“在……看来”明确说明是谁的观点。
points.noteEn: Unlike 看来, 在…看来 makes clear whose view it is.

points.name: 固定短语“不一会儿”
points.explainEn: Use 不一会儿 to mean “after a short while / soon”.
points.structure: 不一会儿，+ 新情况

examples.en: After a short while, the car came.

examples.zh: 他进去不一会儿就出来了。
examples.en: He came out soon after going in.
Soon, everyone arrived.

exercises.q: 填空：___，车就来了。
翻译：Soon, everyone arrived.
排序：不一会儿 / 就 / 他 / 回来了
exercises.body: 不一会儿 / 就 / 他 / 回来了

points.note: 表示经过的时间很短。
points.noteEn: Means only a short time passed.

lessons.title: 我听说有的熊猫出国了

points.name: 并列复句“一会儿……，一会儿……”
points.explainEn: Use 一会儿…一会儿… when two actions or states alternate.
points.structure: 一会儿 + A，一会儿 + B

examples.zh: 天气一会儿晴，一会儿下雨。
examples.en: The weather is sunny one moment and rainy the next.

examples.zh: 他一会儿看书，一会儿看手机。
examples.en: He reads for a while, then looks at his phone.

examples.zh: 孩子一会儿笑，一会儿哭。
examples.en: The child laughs one moment and cries the next.

exercises.q: 填空：天气___晴，___下雨。
翻译：The child laughs one moment and cries the next.
exercises.a: 孩子一会儿笑，一会儿哭。
exercises.body: The child laughs one moment and cries the next.

exercises.q: 连接：他看书。他看手机。（表示来回变化）
exercises.a: 他一会儿看书，一会儿看手机。
exercises.body: 他看书。他看手机。（表示来回变化）

points.note: 重点是两个动作或状态交替出现，不是同时发生。
points.noteEn: The point is two actions alternate, not happen at once.

points.name: 介词“关于”
points.explainEn: Use 关于 before a topic to mean “about / concerning”.
points.structure: 关于 + 话题 +（的）+ 名词/句子

examples.zh: 关于这个问题，我想再说两句。
examples.en: I want to say a little more about this question.

examples.zh: 这是一本关于中国文化的书。
examples.en: This is a book about Chinese culture.

examples.zh: 关于明天的考试，老师说了很多。
examples.en: The teacher said a lot about tomorrow’s test.

exercises.q: 填空：___这个问题，我想说两句。
翻译：a book about Chinese culture
exercises.a: 一本关于中国文化的书

exercises.q: 排序：关于 / 老师 / 考试 / 说了很多
exercises.a: 老师关于考试说了很多。
exercises.body: 关于 / 老师 / 考试 / 说了很多

points.note: “关于 + 话题”常放在句首；修饰名词时常用“关于……的 + 名词”。
points.noteEn: 关于 + topic often opens the sentence; to modify a noun use 关于…的 + noun.

points.name: 固定短语“一般来说”
points.explainEn: Use 一般来说 to mean “generally speaking / in general”.
points.structure: 一般来说，+ 一般情况

examples.zh: 一般来说，冬天比秋天冷。
examples.en: Generally speaking, winter is colder than autumn.

examples.zh: 一般来说，年轻人学得比较快。
examples.en: Generally speaking, young people learn relatively quickly.

examples.zh: 一般来说，这里的春天很舒服。
examples.en: Generally speaking, spring here is comfortable.

exercises.q: 填空：___，冬天比较冷。
翻译：Generally speaking, young people learn quickly.
exercises.a: 一般来说，年轻人学得比较快。
exercises.body: Generally speaking, young people learn quickly.

exercises.q: 选择：“in general”用（一般来说 / 不一会儿）。
exercises.body: “in general”用（一般来说 / 不一会儿）。

points.note: 用于说明通常情况，不表示每一个人或每一种情况都完全如此。
points.noteEn: States the general case, not that every single instance is so.

points.name: 比较句（11）：比 + 多/少/早/晚 + 动词 + 数量
points.explainEn: Use 比 + 多/少/早/晚 + verb + amount to show an exact difference in an action.
points.structure: A + 比 + B + 多/少/早/晚 + 动词 + 数量

examples.zh: 我今天比昨天早起半个小时。
examples.en: I got up half an hour earlier today than yesterday.

examples.zh: 他比我多学了一年中文。
examples.en: He has studied Chinese one year longer than I have.

examples.zh: 这家店比那家晚关门一个小时。
examples.en: This shop closes one hour later than that one.

exercises.q: 填空：我今天比昨天___起半个小时。
exercises.body: 我今天比昨天___起半个小时。

exercises.q: 翻译：He has studied Chinese one year longer than I have.
exercises.a: 他比我多学了一年中文。
exercises.body: He has studied Chinese one year longer than I have.

exercises.q: 排序：这家店 / 比那家 / 晚关门 / 一个小时
exercises.a: 这家店比那家晚关门一个小时。
exercises.body: 这家店 / 比那家 / 晚关门 / 一个小时

points.note: 这里比较的是动作在时间或数量上的具体差别。
points.noteEn: Here it compares a concrete difference in time or amount of an action.

lessons.title: 我要多向认真的人学习

points.name: 介词“向”
points.explainEn: Use 向 + person/direction before a verb to mean “toward / to / from someone”.
points.structure: 向 + 人/方向 + 动词

examples.en: I want to learn from the teacher.
He introduced himself to everyone.
Please walk forward.

exercises.q: 填空：我要___老师学习。
翻译：He introduced himself to everyone.
排序：向 / 请 / 前 / 走
exercises.body: 向 / 请 / 前 / 走

points.note: “向”常引出动作的方向或对象，如“向老师学习、向大家介绍”。
points.noteEn: 向 introduces direction/target, e.g. 向老师学习, 向大家介绍.

points.name: 反问句“不是……吗？”
points.explainEn: Use 不是…吗？ to remind or challenge someone about something you think is already true.
points.structure: 不是 + 句子 + 吗？

examples.en: Didn’t you say you were coming today?
Isn’t he a teacher?
Haven’t we already met?

exercises.q: 填空：你___说今天来___？
翻译：Isn’t he a teacher?
把“我们已经见过”改成反问句。

points.note: 形式是问句，但常常不是为了得到新信息，而是强调说话人的判断。
points.noteEn: It's a question in form but stresses the speaker's judgement, not new info.

points.name: 递进复句“……，更……”
points.explainEn: Use 更 in the second part to add a stronger or higher-degree point: “even more”.
points.structure: A，B + 更 + 形容词/动词

examples.zh: 这本书很好，那本书更有意思。
examples.en: This book is good; that one is even more interesting.
It is cold in the daytime and even colder at night.

examples.zh: 我喜欢中文，更喜欢中文课。
examples.en: I like Chinese, and I like Chinese class even more.

exercises.q: 填空：白天很冷，晚上___冷。
翻译：That book is even more interesting.
exercises.body: That book is even more interesting.

exercises.q: 连接：我喜欢中文。我更喜欢中文课。
exercises.a: 我喜欢中文，更喜欢中文课。
exercises.body: 我喜欢中文。我更喜欢中文课。

points.note: 第二部分在前一层意思上进一步加强程度。
points.noteEn: The second part intensifies the degree of the first.

points.name: 条件复句“只有……，才……”
points.explainEn: Use 只有…才… to mean “only if… then…”. The first condition is necessary.
points.structure: 只有 + 必要条件，才 + 结果

examples.zh: 只有多练习，中文才会进步。
examples.en: Only with more practice will your Chinese improve.
Only if you have a ticket can you go in.

examples.zh: 只有周末，我才有时间运动。
examples.en: Only on weekends do I have time to exercise.

exercises.q: 填空：___多练习，中文___会进步。
翻译：Only on weekends do I have time to exercise.
exercises.a: 只有周末，我才有时间运动。
exercises.body: Only on weekends do I have time to exercise.

exercises.q: 补全：只有有票，___能进去。

points.note: “只有”提出必须满足的条件；没有这个条件，后面的结果通常不能发生。
points.noteEn: 只有 gives a necessary condition; without it, the result can't happen.

points.name: 概数表达法
points.explainEn: Use nearby numbers or words such as 来/左右 to give an approximate number.
points.structure: 相邻数字 + 量词；数量 + 来/左右

examples.en: I waited for two or three minutes.
There are about thirty or forty people in the classroom.
He is around thirty years old.

exercises.q: 填空：我等了___分钟。（2–3）
翻译：about thirty or forty people
写中文：around thirty years old

points.note: 概数表示大概数量。本级重点复习相邻数字连用，并理解“来、左右”等常见约数形式。
points.noteEn: Approximate numbers: review adjacent-number pairs and forms like 来/左右.

points.name: “刚才”和“刚刚”
points.explainEn: Both mean “just now”. 刚才 is a time noun; 刚刚 is an adverb and stays close to the verb.
points.structure: 刚才 + 句子；主语 + 刚刚 + 动词

examples.zh: 刚才老师给我打电话了。
examples.en: The teacher called me just now.
I just got home.
Where did you go just now?

exercises.q: 填空：___老师还在这里。
填空：我___到学校。
翻译：Where did you go just now?
exercises.body: Where did you go just now?

points.note: “刚才”可以单独作时间成分；“刚刚”是副词，通常放在动词前。
points.noteEn: 刚才 can stand as a time word; 刚刚 is an adverb, usually before the verb.

points.name: 条件复句“只要……，就……”
points.explainEn: Use 只要…就… to mean “as long as… then…”.
points.structure: 只要 + 条件，就 + 结果

examples.en: As long as you work hard, you will improve.
As long as it does not rain, we will go.

examples.zh: 只要有时间，我就练习中文。
examples.en: As long as I have time, I practice Chinese.

exercises.q: 填空：___你努力，___会进步。
翻译：As long as it does not rain, we will go.
exercises.body: As long as it does not rain, we will go.

exercises.q: 补全：只要有时间，我___练习中文。
exercises.body: 只要有时间，我___练习中文。

points.note: “只要”表示这个条件一满足，后面的结果就能够发生。和“只有……才……”要注意区分。
points.noteEn: 只要: once met, the result can happen—distinguish from 只有…才….

points.name: 固定格式“从……起”
points.explainEn: Use 从…起 to mean “starting from… / from…on”.
points.structure: 从 + 时间/地点 + 起

examples.en: Starting tomorrow, I will get up early every day.

examples.zh: 从下个月起，我们换新教室。
examples.en: Starting next month, we will use a new classroom.
Starting from here, keep walking forward.

exercises.q: 填空：___明天___，我每天运动。
翻译：Starting next month, we will use a new classroom.
exercises.a: 从下个月起，我们换新教室。
exercises.body: Starting next month, we will use a new classroom.

exercises.q: 排序：从 / 这里 / 起 / 往前走
exercises.body: 从 / 这里 / 起 / 往前走

points.note: “从……起”强调一个新的时间或空间起点。
points.noteEn: 从…起 stresses a new starting point in time or space.
